SELECT count(*) total,count(*) FILTER(WHERE x->>'operational_class'='ACTIVE') t,count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT(x->>'operational_class'='ACTIVE')) f,count(*) FILTER(WHERE (x->>'operational_class'='ACTIVE') IS NULL) n,count(DISTINCT x->>'dedupe_key') deduplicated FROM public.lf_eventos l CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(l.payload->'sql_callers') x WHERE l.id=20161

SELECT count(*) total,count(*) FILTER(WHERE x->>'operational_class'='ACTIVE') t,count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT(x->>'operational_class'='ACTIVE')) f,count(*) FILTER(WHERE (x->>'operational_class'='ACTIVE') IS NULL) n FROM public.lf_eventos l CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(l.payload->'external_inventory') x WHERE l.id=20161

SELECT count(*) total,count(*) FILTER(WHERE x->>'definition_md5' ~ '^[a-f0-9]{32}$') valid,count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT(x->>'definition_md5' ~ '^[a-f0-9]{32}$')) invalid,count(*) FILTER(WHERE (x->>'definition_md5' ~ '^[a-f0-9]{32}$') IS NULL) unknown FROM public.lf_eventos l CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(l.payload->'sql_callers') x WHERE l.id=20161

WITH samples(v) AS (VALUES ('ACTIVE'::text),('INACTIVE'::text),(NULL::text)) SELECT count(*) total,count(*) FILTER (WHERE v='ACTIVE') t,count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT(v='ACTIVE')) f,count(*) FILTER (WHERE (v='ACTIVE') IS NULL) n FROM samples
WITH examples(expected_n,observed_n) AS (VALUES (38,38),(38,37),(38,NULL::int)) SELECT expected_n,observed_n,(expected_n=observed_n) IS TRUE as accepted FROM examples ORDER BY observed_n NULLS LAST
